questions.question: Starting from the blue ball hopper with the solved board configuration, describe the complete path of the first blue ball.
questions.answer: The first blue ball drops from (2, -1), rolls onto ramp_right at (3, 0), then ramp_right at (4, 1), then ramp_right at (5, 2), then ramp_right at (6, 3), then ramp_right at (7, 4), then ramp_right at (8, 5), then ramp_left at (9, 6), then ramp_left at (8, 7), then ramp_left at (7, 8), then ramp_left at (6, 9), then ramp_left at (5, 10), and is caught at the left exit.

questions.question: In what order do balls exit the machine?
questions.answer: 8 balls reach an exit in the order: blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left. 8 exit left, 0 exit right, 0 are intercepted.

questions.question: How many ramps were placed by the solution?
questions.answer: There are 11 (6 ramp_right, 5 ramp_left) on the board.
